# lambda-function

Core module for creating an AWS Lambda function with IAM role, CloudWatch log group, and optional VPC configuration.

## Usage

```hcl
module "my_function" {
  source = "../../modules/lambda-function"

  function_name = "my-handler"

  zip = {
    filename = "dist/handler.zip"
    runtime  = "python3.12"
    handler  = "main.handler"
  }

  tags = {
    Team = "platform"
  }
}
```

## Inputs

### Required

| Name | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `function_name` | `string` | Name of the Lambda function. Used for the function itself, the IAM role, and the CloudWatch log group. Must be unique within the AWS account and region. |

### Packaging (exactly one required)

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `zip` | `object` | `null` | Zip packaging configuration. Mutually exclusive with `image`. |
| `image` | `object` | `null` | Container image packaging configuration. Mutually exclusive with `zip`. |

**`zip` object fields:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `filename` | `string` | Path to the local zip file containing the function code. The module uses `filebase64sha256()` on this file to detect changes and trigger redeployments. |
| `runtime` | `string` | Lambda runtime identifier. Examples: `python3.12`, `python3.11`, `nodejs20.x`, `nodejs18.x`, `java21`, `java17`, `dotnet8`, `ruby3.3`, `provided.al2023`. See [AWS Lambda runtimes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html) for the full list. |
| `handler` | `string` | Function entrypoint in the format `file.function`. Examples: `main.handler` (Python), `index.handler` (Node.js), `com.example.Handler::handleRequest` (Java). |

**`image` object fields:**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `uri` | `string` | Yes | ECR image URI. The image must already be pushed to ECR. Format: `<account>.dkr.ecr.<region>.amazonaws.com/<repo>:<tag>` |
| `command` | `list(string)` | No | Override the container `CMD`. Each element is a separate argument. |
| `entry_point` | `list(string)` | No | Override the container `ENTRYPOINT`. |
| `working_directory` | `string` | No | Override the container working directory. |

### Optional: Function Configuration

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `description` | `string` | `null` | Human-readable description of the Lambda function. |
| `memory_size` | `number` | `128` | Amount of memory in MB available to the function at runtime. Range: `128` to `10240`. CPU power scales linearly with memory. |
| `timeout` | `number` | `3` | Maximum execution time in seconds before the function is terminated. Range: `1` to `900` (15 minutes). |
| `architecture` | `string` | `"x86_64"` | Instruction set architecture. Possible values: `"x86_64"`, `"arm64"`. Arm64 (Graviton2) offers better price-performance for most workloads. |
| `ephemeral_storage` | `number` | `512` | Size of the `/tmp` directory in MB. Range: `512` to `10240`. |
| `layers` | `list(string)` | `[]` | List of Lambda Layer ARNs to attach. Maximum 5 layers. Only applies to zip-packaged functions (ignored for container images). |
| `publish` | `bool` | `false` | Whether to publish a new version of the Lambda function on each update. Required for aliases and weighted traffic shifting. |
| `environment_variables` | `map(string)` | `{}` | Map of environment variables injected into the function runtime. Keys and values must be strings. |

### Optional: IAM

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `existing_role_arn` | `string` | `null` | ARN of an existing IAM role. When `null` (default), the module creates a dedicated role with CloudWatch Logs permissions. When set, the module uses the provided role and does not create one. |
| `attach_log_policy` | `bool` | `true` | Whether to attach the CloudWatch Logs IAM policy to a BYO role. Only relevant when `existing_role_arn` is set. Set to `false` if your existing role already has log permissions. |

### Optional: Logging

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `log_retention_in_days` | `number` | `7` | Number of days to retain CloudWatch logs. Possible values: `1`, `3`, `5`, `7`, `14`, `30`, `60`, `90`, `120`, `150`, `180`, `365`, `400`, `545`, `731`, `1096`, `1827`, `2192`, `2557`, `2922`, `3288`, `3653`, `0` (never expire). |

### Optional: VPC

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `subnet_ids` | `list(string)` | `[]` | List of subnet IDs for VPC configuration. Must be provided together with `security_group_ids`. When both are set, the Lambda function runs inside the VPC. |
| `security_group_ids` | `list(string)` | `[]` | List of security group IDs for VPC configuration. Must be provided together with `subnet_ids`. |

### Optional: EFS

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `efs_config` | `object` | `null` | EFS mount configuration. When set, mounts an EFS access point into the function. Requires VPC config. See fields below. |

**`efs_config` object fields:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `access_point_arn` | `string` | ARN of the EFS access point to mount. The module attaches a least-privilege IAM policy (`elasticfilesystem:ClientMount`/`ClientWrite`/`ClientRootAccess`) scoped to this access point. |
| `local_mount_path` | `string` | Path where the file system is mounted in the function. **Must start with `/mnt`** (AWS requirement). |

**Caveats:**
- Requires `subnet_ids` and `security_group_ids` (EFS access needs VPC networking). A precondition enforces this.
- The EFS **mount targets must exist in the function's subnets before the function is created**. The module cannot infer this ordering from an ARN string — add `depends_on = [aws_efs_mount_target.<name>]` in the calling configuration (see `examples/efs/`).

### Optional: Tags

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `tags` | `map(string)` | `{}` | Map of tags applied to all resources created by the module (function, role, log group). |

## Outputs

| Name | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `function_name` | Name of the Lambda function. |
| `function_arn` | ARN of the Lambda function. |
| `invoke_arn` | Invocation ARN of the Lambda function. Used by API Gateway integration. |
| `role_name` | Name of the IAM execution role. `null` if using a BYO role. |
| `role_arn` | ARN of the IAM execution role (created or BYO). |
| `log_group_name` | Name of the CloudWatch Log Group (`/aws/lambda/<function_name>`). |
